title: Warm Wilted French Kale Gratin
description: A sour and snappy French dish featuring kale, this plant-based friendly gratin is a nostalgic treat, reduced to perfection to bring out the natural flavors of the ingredients.

ingredients.name: French kale
ingredients.notes: stems removed and discarded, leaves coarsely chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped kale to the skillet, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Pour in the lemon juice and apple cider vinegar, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the kale is wilted.
Stir in the nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the kale mixture to a baking dish and pour in the vegan cream.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until it is lightly browned and the cream is bubbly.
